name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
title: Bharti Airtel Ltd - 532454 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Telco is supply-disciplined but ARPU stalled: Q4 ARPU Rs.257 up only Rs.3 QoQ, management "not happy", with radio capex moderating and FY27 capex guided "in the ballpark" of FY26's ~Rs.31,000 Cr.

capex.quote: our sense is that we will be in the ballpark of this year, give or take a little bit

triggers.label: ARPU up only Rs.3 QoQ
triggers.quote: We are not happy with the ARPU increase of Rs.3, part of this issue was linked to West Asia crisis

triggers.label: Radio capex moderating in India
triggers.quote: radio capex, as I have mentioned before, is moderating. In Africa, it is growing but in India it is moderating.

triggers.label: Fiber over FWA on chip cost
triggers.quote: The fixed wireless access has now become very much more expensive. So we have pivoted the whole company back to a dramatic obsession on fiber.

triggers.label: Handset prices rising sharply
triggers.quote: handset prices have gone up very sharply in the last few weeks, which we will watch

triggers.label: Dividend Rs.16 to Rs.24/share
triggers.quote: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs.24 per share, a significant increase over last year's Rs.16 per share.

guidance.value: in the ballpark of FY26 (~Rs.31,000 Cr), give or take
guidance.quote: our sense is that we will be in the ballpark of this year, give or take a little bit
The Board recommended a dividend of Rs.24 per share, a significant increase over last year's Rs.16 per share.

red_flags.label: Undisclosed regulatory provision in Hexacom
red_flags.quote: The interpretation of that existing thing has been changed and accordingly it has been provided for.

red_flags.label: Management evasion on tariff and pricing path
red_flags.quote: As of now, it is a competitive market. We will not do anything that will hurt our business.

evasions.quote: Let us see how this plays out over time.
I will not get into specific details but it is not a new thing.
I will dodge the bullet of what our targets are, I do not think we give those targets out.
